messages:
maria: Quick summary — ran stratified rollout of v2-int4 (short-answers + long-doc mix) to 8% traffic split across cohorts at 11:12. Initial smoke looked OK but some slice-level drift showed up after ~18k requests.
sam: Which slices drifted?
maria: Short answers (FAQ) precision down ~1.8% and long-doc retrieval MRR down 2.6%. 95p latency up ~45ms on dedicated hosts.
jordan: 2.6% MRR is in the amber zone — what's our auto-fallback policy?\maria: Current idea: combine a quality delta and latency tail rule so we don't flip on noisy short-term blips. Draft rule: fallback when (MRR_delta <= -2.0% over 30m AND p_value <= 0.05) OR (95p_latency_increase >= 40ms sustained for 15m).
anya: Tightening the p-value to 0.01 would reduce false positives but delay response. I prefer 0.05 + a minimum sample floor.
sam: Can we add hysteresis so we don't re-promote immediately? e.g., need 2 consecutive 30m windows passing to promote back.
jordan: Agree. Also suggest cohort-weighted thresholds: allow slightly higher degradation on low-risk cohorts (internal QA) but tighten for search/live cohorts.
maria: I sketched a config we can push to the rollout engine:
```json
{
  "name": "v2-int4-stratified-rollout",
  "traffic_split": "8%",
  "slices": ["faq-short","longdoc-search","system-messages"],
  "fallback_rules": [
    {"type": "quality","metric": "mrr","window_mins": 30,"threshold_pct": -2.0,"p_value": 0.05,"min_samples": 5000},
    {"type": "latency","metric": "p95_ms","window_mins": 15,"threshold_ms": 40}
  ],
  "promotion_hysteresis": {"consecutive_windows": 2},
  "cohort_overrides": {"internal": {"threshold_pct": -3.5}, "search": {"threshold_pct": -1.0}}
}
```
sam: Nice. What about error-rate anomalies? We saw a handful of 5xx in the logs earlier on a single host.
maria: Logs show 5xx spikes tied to TF32 kernel fallback on one node; ops already cordoned the node. That doesn't appear systemic. Putting a host-level circuit-breaker into the config: if host_error_rate > 1.0% for 10m, route away.
jordan: For the statistical gate, are we using bootstrap or analytic t-test? Bootstrapping is more robust for skewed MRR distributions.
maria: Using bootstrap on per-slice, per-cohort samples — the engine returns a delta and bootstrapped CI + p-value. We rely on the p-value from bootstrap.
anya: How are we surfacing this in Console? Need a per-slice watchlist widget and an automated slack alert when both rules trigger.
maria: Yep — console will show the delta, CI, p-value, and a small histogram. Will add a watchlist alert to #eng-ml and #prod-alerts. Alert text will include: slice, cohort, sample_count, delta_pct, p_value, p95_delta_ms, deploy_id.
deploy-bot: rollouts: rollout v2-int4 8% to cohorts [faq-short,longdoc-search] started by maria at 2024-05-23T11:12:01Z.
sam: Operational checklist before widening: (1) run a 60m extended smoke on search cohort, (2) run 100k synthetic queries for long-doc slice, (3) ensure telemetry retention for the next 48h.
maria: Plan: pause promotion until we have 2x 30m windows with p_value>0.05 and delta within +/-0.5% on production slices. If any slice fails quality AND latency rule fires, auto-fallback will run a fast rollback to last pinned model and notify #eng-ml + oncall.
jordan: One more edge case: prefix-caching differences between quantized and fp32 cause tokenization drift for very short prompts. Add a token-prefix sanity check to offline evals (compare top-1 token distribution).
anya: I'll add that to the onboarding checklist and the eval harness. Also adding a smoke eval that computes top-token KL for first-token across 10k queries. Threshold 0.12.
sam: Who will own the rollout-watchlist runbook?
maria: I will own doc + runbook this week, will ping for reviews. If we see repeated false positives we can relax p_value or increase min_samples later. :eyes:
deploy-bot: alert: node-az3-qp4 cordoned by ops at 2024-05-23T11:28:14Z due to kernel fallback.
maria: Thanks — ops, please uncordon when kernel patched. For now, will resume monitoring and hold promotion until tomorrow AM.
anya: LGTM. I updated the onboarding checklist in docs and added the bootstrap test snippet.
sam: Thanks team. We'll reconvene at 09:30 tomorrow to decide on widen.
maria: Closing action items: anya - add tests + deck; jordan - run synthetic 100k; sam - extend smoke; I'll push config to staging and link consoles.
